name: mcp-server-vet
description: Read-only inspection of a third-party MCP server BEFORE it is added or trusted: scans tool descriptions and scopes for poisoning, returns an add, decline or sandbox verdict for a human. Never installs. Do not use to vet a skill or plugin (use skill-vet), to review first-party code (use review-hard or security-review), or to fetch a remote server definition (record its origin via capture-references, then get a local copy out of band).

findings.excerpt: - **Step 0: Provenance gate (runs FIRST, and can end the vet on its own).** Resolve the declared package or binary name against the vendor's canonical registry
